headline: New fiscal year: credit expansion, monsoon hydropower output, and Q4 earnings season underway
message: Nepal's new fiscal year began in mid-July, historically accompanied by faster loan approvals and easing interest rates as banks reset annual lending targets and disburse fresh credit. August has also historically tended to be a relatively stronger month for NEPSE turnover. Hydropower generators typically post stronger output during the monsoon season due to higher water flow, and many listed companies are releasing annual/Q4 financial reports in this window, which tends to draw retail investor attention and lift trading volume across the board.
verdict_message: Multiple broad, recurring seasonal factors (fiscal-year credit expansion, monsoon-driven hydropower output, annual earnings season) are active market-wide right now. This context supports but does not replace the technical verdict above -- treat it as directional backdrop, not a standalone signal.
